items.headline: Nearly $2 million new home permitted on Fleming Avenue
items.summary: A single-family home valued at $1,994,121 was permitted at 1370 Fleming Avenue, a construction cost well above the other new homes in this batch.

items.headline: Five-lot subdivision permitted off Britton Ave and Camino Ramon
items.summary: Permits were issued for five new single-family homes on Lots 1-5 at 1300, 1304, 1308 Britton Avenue and 1205, 1225 Camino Ramon, along with three attached ADUs on Lots 1, 4, and 5 — adding up to eight new residential units cleared to build on what appear to be newly subdivided parcels.

items.headline: Council to weigh higher affordable housing requirements for new projects
items.summary: A study session is scheduled to consider raising inclusionary housing requirements and updating the in-lieu fees developers pay instead of building below-market-rate units, for both new rental and ownership housing.

items.headline: Eight homes proposed to replace one house on Wolfe Rd
items.summary: A developer is seeking permits to tear down a single-family home at 781 S Wolfe Rd and build eight two-story houses on separate lots, along with a common lot, on the 0.57-acre parcel.

items.headline: Design board weighed rules for cell equipment on streets
items.summary: The Architectural Review Board took up a staff recommendation on process and design standards for two categories of wireless communication equipment installed in the public right-of-way, such as on utility poles and other street structures.
